# Inter

Unmodified Inter 4.1 variable upright WOFF2, served locally from the embedded
`assets/vendor` directory. No font CDN or additional embed rule is required.

- Upstream: https://github.com/rsms/inter
- Pinned release: v4.1, commit `e3a3d4c57d5ecc01453a575621882a384c1995a3`
- Font: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsms/inter/e3a3d4c57d5ecc01453a575621882a384c1995a3/docs/font-files/InterVariable.woff2
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, adjacent `LICENSE.txt` from the same commit
- SHA-256: `693b77d4f32ee9b8bfc995589b5fad5e99adf2832738661f5402f9978429a8e3`

Only the upright face is included; code and terminal text retain their monospace
fonts. The CSS uses `font-display: swap` and a system sans-serif fallback.
